maintenance_led.reason: Sells newly manufactured battery cells, packs and energy storage systems to OEMs for new vehicles and equipment, not aftermarket servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private commercial vehicle, bus and equipment makers and energy storage buyers; revenue is not mainly government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from its own vertically integrated battery manufacturing and R&D, with no steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Custom battery packs are qualified into customers' vehicles and equipment, so switching needs re-qualification, redesign and downtime.
